name: DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.layersAuxM.eq_def
typeText:
∀ {ν : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} ν] (N : DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network ν) (c : ν → Nat)
  (U : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} ν ν)) (x : Nat) (x_1 x_2 : List.{0} ν),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.layersAuxM N c U x x_1 x_2)
    (match x, x_1, x_2 with
    | 0, x, front => do
      DisequalityDispersion.Costed.tick (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (List.length.{0} front) 1)
      Pure.pure.{0, 0} (List.cons.{0} front List.nil.{0})
    | Nat.succ k, seen, front => do
      DisequalityDispersion.Costed.tick
          (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
            (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.natC (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} k 1)) (List.length.{0} front))
            1)
      let nf ← DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.newFrontM N c U seen front
      DisequalityDispersion.Costed.tick (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (List.length.{0} seen) (List.length.{0} front))
      let rest ← DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.layersAuxM N c U k (HAppend.hAppend.{0, 0, 0} seen front) nf
      Pure.pure.{0, 0} (List.cons.{0} front rest))
